title: Docus AI lab-result analysis, Armenia
summary: Armenian startup Docus launched AI analysis of lab results with the Blood Cells lab network; described as the first AI use in Armenian healthcare. The Health Minister presented it and said medical-data law needs changes.
fact: First reported AI tool in Armenian healthcare analyzes lab data (Docus with Blood Cells).
caution: Verify the date. No Armenian hospital has announced generative AI.
